scope: Synthetic loopback HTTP and simultaneous independent workers on one shared host
receipt_policy: Individual read arrays are summarized; full local receipts are fingerprinted below. Reproduction commands emit full receipts.
host_activity: Benchmarks ran sequentially. Interactive applications and Databricks trial setup were active; two small offline SQL regression runs overlapped the eviction run. Host load and OS caches were uncontrolled.

environment.cache: OS and shared catalog caches uncontrolled; first means first graph call per tenant

configuration.fixture: seeded mixed controls/outcomes/asset types; every tenant shares source account shared-account-a

limitations: Authenticated loopback HTTP, one Uvicorn process with default thread-pool and rate limits
Balanced and 4:1 skewed client submissions; client queue delay is not server scheduler delay
Explicit 503 admission and 429 rate-limit rejections are retained per tenant; they are not retried
Client and server share one process and host; RSS and CPU include both
Synthetic normalized records, SQLite state, no evaluation jobs or provider evidence
Response body bytes exclude HTTP headers; no production fairness, SLO or capacity budget
No object-store failover, crash recovery or distributed admission qualification
